paragraphs.source_en: When they whip Eo, I try not to watch. But it hurts more to abandon her. Her eyes find mine. They shine like rubies, twitch every time the lash falls. Soon this will be over, my love. Soon we will go back to life. Just last the lash and we get everything back. But can she even take so many lashes?

units.source_en: When they whip Eo, I try not to watch.
But it hurts more to abandon her.
Her eyes find mine.
They shine like rubies, twitch every time the lash falls.
Soon this will be over, my love.
Soon we will go back to life.
Just last the lash and we get everything back.
But can she even take so many lashes?

paragraphs.source_en: “End it,” I say to the Tinpot beside me. “End it!” I beg of him. “I’ll do anything. I’ll obey. I’ll take her lashes. Just end it, you bloodydamn bastards! End it!”

units.source_en: End it!”

paragraphs.source_en: The ArchGovernor looks down at me, but his face is golden, poreless, and without care. I am nothing but the bloodiest of ants. My sacrifice will impress him. He’ll feel compassion if I abase myself, if I throw myself into the fire for love. He’ll feel pity. This is how the stories go.

units.source_en: The ArchGovernor looks down at me, but his face is golden, poreless, and without care.
I am nothing but the bloodiest of ants.
My sacrifice will impress him.
He’ll feel compassion if I abase myself, if I throw myself into the fire for love.
He’ll feel pity.
This is how the stories go.

paragraphs.source_en: “Your Excellency, give me her punishment!” I plead. “Please!” I beg because in my wife’s eyes I see something that terrifies me. I see fight in her as they streak her back bloody. I see anger building inside her. There is a reason she is not afraid.

units.source_en: “Your Excellency, give me her punishment!”
I plead.
“Please!”
I beg because in my wife’s eyes I see something that terrifies me.
I see fight in her as they streak her back bloody.
I see anger building inside her.
There is a reason she is not afraid.

paragraphs.source_en: “No. No. No,” I plead to her. “No, Eo. Please, no!”

units.source_en: “No.
No.
No,” I plead to her.
“No, Eo.
Please, no!”

paragraphs.source_en: “Gag that wretched thing! He prickles the ArchGovernor’s ears,” Podginus orders. Bridge forces a knot of stone into my mouth. I gag and cry.

units.source_en: “Gag that wretched thing!
He prickles the ArchGovernor’s ears,” Podginus orders.
Bridge forces a knot of stone into my mouth.
I gag and cry.

paragraphs.source_en: As the thirteenth lash falls, as I mumble for her not to do it, Eo stares into my eyes one last moment and then she begins her song. It is a quiet sound, a mournful sound, like the song the deep mines whisper as wind moves in the abandoned shafts. It is the song of death and lament, the song that is forbidden. The song I have only heard once before.

units.source_en: As the thirteenth lash falls, as I mumble for her not to do it, Eo stares into my eyes one last moment and then she begins her song.
It is a quiet sound, a mournful sound, like the song the deep mines whisper as wind moves in the abandoned shafts.
It is the song of death and lament, the song that is forbidden.
The song I have only heard once before.

paragraphs.source_en: For this, they will kill her.

units.source_en: For this, they will kill her.

paragraphs.source_en: Her voice is soft and true, never as beautiful as her. It echoes across the Common, rising up like a Siren’s unearthly call. The lashes pause. The headTalks shiver. Even the Tinpots sadly shake their heads when they place the words. Few men truly like seeing beauty burn.

paragraphs.source_en: Podginus glances embarrassedly over at ArchGovernor Augustus, who descends on golden gravBoots to watch more closely. His shining hair glistens against his noble brow. High cheekbones catch the light. Those golden eyes examine my wife as though a worm had suddenly sprouted a butterfly’s wings. His scar curves as he speaks with a voice dripping power.

units.source_en: Podginus glances embarrassedly over at ArchGovernor Augustus, who descends on golden gravBoots to watch more closely.
His shining hair glistens against his noble brow.
High cheekbones catch the light.
Those golden eyes examine my wife as though a worm had suddenly sprouted a butterfly’s wings.
His scar curves as he speaks with a voice dripping power.

paragraphs.source_en: “Let her sing,” he says to Podginus, not bothering to hide his fascination.

units.source_en: “Let her sing,” he says to Podginus, not bothering to hide his fascination.
“But, my lord …”

paragraphs.source_en: “No animal but man throws themselves willingly into the flames, Copper. Relish the sight. You’ll not see it again.” To his camera crew: “Continue recording. We will edit out the parts we find intolerable.”

Relish the sight.
You’ll not see it again.”

paragraphs.source_en: How futile his words make her sacrifice seem.
